text: Barclays PLC is a UK-listed bank whose only notifiable holder above the 3% disclosure threshold as at 31 December 2025 is BlackRock (about 5.8% in 2024), with no state stake since the UK government's 2008 crisis holding was sold. The human-rights relevant record is conduct: LIBOR and mis-selling fines, and a leading European position in fossil-fuel financing. Concern, not serious, because ownership is purely private.
